text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 230 Woolner Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated August 22, 2017, regarding the property located at 230 Woolner Avenue, with the following condition: a. The garbage chutes may be closed provided that all elements of the City of Toronto's garbage chute closure programme, as at July 10, 2018, and amended from time to time, be immediately implemented and maintained in perpetuity.
